questions.stem: What is the function of a diode in a circuit?

options.text: It allows current to flow in one direction only

questions.explanation: A diode allows current to flow in one direction only (forward bias) and blocks current in the reverse direction. This makes diodes useful for converting alternating current (AC) to direct current (DC).

questions.stem: What happens to the resistance of a light-dependent resistor (LDR) when light intensity increases?
questions.explanation: When light intensity increases, the resistance of an LDR decreases. This is because more light energy releases more charge carriers in the semiconductor material, making it easier for current to flow.
